parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=11;fontColor=#666666;" value="Solid line = a request or data flow.&nbsp; Orange = a call into the engine, by a rule's name.&nbsp; Dashed grey line = a hand-off outside the request path (the promoted model).&nbsp; Dashed border = runs in-process.&nbsp; The shared stores: ingest and weather write them, the charts job fills the tiles, the planner reads them and says when a feed goes stale; the live store is the live-store Docker volume (SQLite needs shared memory the Mac’s file sharing lacks), so no request waits on a live fetch (#535).&nbsp; Services: gateway, planner, ingest, weather, db, mailpit; the jobs (retrain, charts, charts-overlays, charts-next), ml, web-build, jaeger and dev-services start only on request (their profiles)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="1320" x="40" y="1375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Solid line = a request or data flow. Orange = a call into the engine, by a rule's name. Dashed grey line = a hand-off outside the request path (the promoted model). Dashed border = runs in-process. The shared stores: ingest and weather write them, the charts job fills the tiles, the planner reads them and says when a feed goes stale; the live store is the live-store Docker volume (SQLite needs shared memory the Mac’s file sharing lacks), so no request waits on a live fetch (#535). Services: gateway, planner, ingest, weather, db, mailpit; the jobs (retrain, charts, charts-overlays, charts-next), ml, web-build, jaeger and dev-services start only on request (their profiles).
